references.text: This reference covers the entire context where the chief priests and Pharisees gather to discuss Jesus' fate, culminating in the decision to kill him in verse 53.
Here the narrative continues immediately after the decision in 11:53, where they plan to kill not only Jesus but also Lazarus as a result of the same conspiracy.
This is a direct parallel where the chief priests and elders gather to plot to take Jesus' life by deceit, reflecting the same conspiracy that began in John 11:53.
Markus reports on the same event where they sought a way to take Jesus' life, confirming that the decision was made shortly before Passover, just as in John.
Here the same conspiracy is described where they sought to destroy Jesus but feared the crowd, showing the ongoing planning that was formalized in John 11:53.
John refers back to the decision in 11:53 by quoting Caiaphas' prophetic words that it is better for one man to die for the people, which was the basis for the decision to kill Jesus.
